questions.prompt: Which statement gives the core rule for “Closures and iterator adapters”?
options: Cargo is the main tool for creating, building, and testing projects.
Use rustup to keep toolchain updates and installed versions explicit.
filter selects items, map transforms them, and collect creates a Vec.
Rust bindings are immutable unless declared mut.
questions.answer: filter selects items, map transforms them, and collect creates a Vec.
questions.explanation:
filter selects items, map transforms them, and collect creates a Vec.
Why: A closure is an anonymous function that can capture values from its environment; `Fn`, `FnMut`, and `FnOnce` describe how it captures and can be called. Iterator adapters such as `map`, `filter`, and `take` build lazy pipelines, while `collect` and `fold` consume results. Lazy work begins at a terminal operation, so measure memory and performance for large streams.
